title: Framer prompt CTA
description: A centred closing title over a dark rounded prompt box whose placeholder text types itself out, holds, clears and moves on to the next idea, with a model label and a round send button, a row of small suggestion chips and a quiet "start without" link. On phones: the title, one white button and a dark panel with a soft blue glow rim.
notes: needs JavaScript for the typing loop (`hydrate: visible`); static HTML and reduced motion show the first prompt
the phone glow panel is a media slot (`media`)
